charter.office: Economic Enterprise Management Division, Albay Public Market
personnelNotes: The Economic Enterprise Management Division is published under the City Mayor's Office and issues a separate charter for each market it runs. This one covers the Albay Public Market.

feedbackMechanism.howToSendFeedback: Answer the client feedback form and drop it in the box at the Albay Public Market Office.
feedbackMechanism.howFeedbackIsProcessed: Issues are discussed so a solution can be reached. A complaint may be filed in writing or verbally at the market office, and the complainant and the respondent appear together at a preliminary conference.

services.title: Being awarded a vacant market stall
services.description: How a vacant stall at the Albay Public Market is awarded, after the vacancy has been posted for thirty days. If only one person applies the stall goes to them; if there is more than one, it is drawn by lot.

requirements.item: Copy of the application letter, acknowledged by the City Mayor's Office

steps.client: Submit a copy of the application letter.
steps.personResponsible: Administrative Aide I / Administrative Aide II

steps.client: Attend the awarding of the stall.
steps.agency: Awards the stall to the sole applicant. Where there is more than one applicant, a drawing of lots is conducted.
Gives the qualified applicant or awardee the essential forms.

steps.client: Fill out the stallholder information sheet, the application to lease a market stall and the licence to conduct business, and sign the lease contract.

steps.agency: Checks and reviews the forms submitted.

steps.client: Wait for the release of the market clearance.

steps.agency: Records and files the duplicate copy of the market clearance.

notes: A stall is only awarded after its vacancy has been posted for thirty days.
verifyNotes: The charter's TOTAL row for this service is blank in the source, so the total shown is summed from the steps alone.

The charter lists eight processing times against seven numbered agency actions. The twenty-five minutes is read here as the client's own time filling out and signing the forms, which is the only step without an agency action. Check the PDF.
The charter numbers its later agency actions 4.1, 5.1 and 5.2 under client step 5. The order is kept as printed.

services.title: Signing a market stall lease contract
services.description: The lease contract between a stallholder and the City Government of Legazpi. The contract goes to the City Mayor's Office for signature, which is what makes this take days rather than minutes.

requirements.whereToSecure: City Treasurer's Office or the barangay

steps.client: Approach the Officer of the Day.
Give a photocopy of the business permit.

steps.agency: Forwards the lease contract to the City Mayor's Office for signature.

steps.client: Wait for the release of the lease contract.

notes: Everything but the last step happens at the market office in under half an hour. The wait is the City Mayor's Office signing.
verifyNotes: The last step is a range, 1 to 3 days. The arithmetic reads the upper figure of a range, which is what makes the derived total match the charter's stated 3 days and 28 minutes.
